operations.description: `_kit_copy` copied the whole repo INCLUDING a gitignored, 4.7 MB `.claude/hooks/hooks.log` that other tests append to via real hook invocations during a full-suite run. Three sibling files already ignore logs for this reason (test_dispatch_merge.py:881, test_install.py:212, test_pipeline_e2e.py:99); this one was the outlier. A full-suite run on 2026-08-24 failed here with shutil.Error from copytree while passing in isolation and passing the whole file in isolation -- consistent with a concurrent append, though NOT proven to be the cause. The change is right regardless: duplicating a churning multi-megabyte log into a throwaway kit copy is waste and a race surface, and the convention already existed.
